CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION {{fn_name}}(input_id INT)
RETURNS TABLE(id INT, name TEXT, score NUMERIC) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT u.id, u.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS score
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.id = input_id
  GROUP BY u.id, u.name;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE;
